title: 36 Hours in Tbilisi
abstract: Gourmands, partyers and aficionados of art and architecture (and shopping) will find no end of riches in the East-meets-West capital of Georgia.

title: 36 Hours in Seville
abstract: Known for its many festivals, Moorish architectural flourishes and, of course, flamenco, the capital of Spain’s Andalusia region is a buoyant city whose many cultures are reflected in its cuisine, buildings, art and history.

title: 36 Hours in Napa Valley
abstract: The venerable vineyards and Michelin-starred restaurants in this California enclave are what everyone comes for. But there are also craft beer breweries, upstart restaurants and, yes, new wineries to explore.

title: 36 Hours in Buffalo
abstract: Classic architecture, international cuisine, adventurous activities and serious art: This Western New York city is blossoming.
